name: Gabrielle's Monster Match
summary:
Gabrielle sneezed her soul right out her body, and only by the help of ghouls and ghosts of Monsterville could she get it back! Now, Gabrielle returns once more to Monsterville to take on another challenge: Puzzles! Mix and match your favorite characters like Vlad, Frankie, and Robert!

See how fast you can match monsters in Time Trial Mode, complete tricky quests in Quest Mode, or see how long you can survive in Endless Mode!
